class: One leg of a paper trade shows its price and P&L in several panels of the same screen, and a panel that reads another endpoint or reply than the page's one book read prints a different LTP and P&L at the same moment. Each reader is correct by itself; the screen contradicts itself.
mechanism: D-41 (25 Nov 2026, builder ?strategy=170): the Paper P&L panel read /strategies/{id}/tracking while the legs table read the page's book read (26000 CE 149.70 vs 150.15). N-07 (26 Nov 2026, builder of paper strategy 172): the P&L Table tab read the outcome reply (its LTP, the plan's Planned entry) while the legs table read the book (25650 PE LTP 166.35 vs 166.20, P&L +695.50 vs +715.00; after a 1-lot exit of a 2-lot leg 25850 CE +45.50 vs +149.50).

first_seen.evidence: owner screen checks 25 and 26 Nov 2026; N-07 red test frontend/tests/pnl-table-one-source-n07.test.js: expected [ '₹999.10', '₹100.00', '₹100.00' ] to deeply equal [ '60.65', '-776.75', '72.60' ]

fix: Every per-leg price / P&L of a paper trade is read through lib/usePaperBookRead (legPricesOf, paperPnlBlock, paperLegsOf), joined by contract id (the page leg carries instrument_id and contract_id). A panel that cannot join a leg keeps its own source and says so in the guard's registry.

detection.note: The guard is a text scan: a file naming a leg price or P&L field must be on its registry, and ChartCard must receive and use paperLegs. Still on the outcome reply for a paper trade (registered as REMAINING): the Full table (StrategyTable), the leg list 'Price has moved ... now' text, Advanced Details.

occurrences.where: D-41 Paper P&L panel vs legs table
N-07 P&L Table tab vs legs table (strategy 172)
